technical_requirements: all 110 results and completion manifests verified
exact Shapley additivity and independent permutation recalculation pass

scene_rule.MATCH: actual first exceeds second by >0.01 mAP and the unique Shapley top is the actual top
scene_rule.INCONCLUSIVE: actual first-second difference <=0.01 mAP or the Shapley top is not unique within 1e-12
scene_rule.MISMATCH: a variable other than the unique Shapley top causes >0.01 mAP more degradation

overall_rule.INDEPENDENT_SHAP_VARIABLE_SELECTION_PASS: technical requirements pass and MATCH>=7 of 10
overall_rule.INDEPENDENT_SHAP_VARIABLE_SELECTION_FAIL: technical requirements pass, MATCH<7, and at least one MISMATCH
overall_rule.INDEPENDENT_SHAP_VARIABLE_SELECTION_INCO: technical requirements pass, MATCH<7, MISMATCH=0, and the shortfall is due only to INCONCLUSIVE scenes
overall_rule.TECHNICAL_INCOMPLETE: any technical requirement is incomplete or fails

auxiliary_only: per-scene and aggregate Spearman rank correlation
